one_line: Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO after political lobbying, OpenAI announced GPT-6 protein design, and Anthropic shares dropped below their IPO price.

themes.title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia CEO role
themes.text: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia as CEO following lobbying by President Donald Trump and Silicon Valley allies, while Trump stated that a government stake in Nvidia and a pardon for Huang remain options.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO after intervention by Trump and tech allies
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologizes for code of conduct violations at first all-hands since return
Trump says pardon for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is 'always an option'
US government may acquire stake in Nvidia, says Trump

themes.title: New reasoning and protein models advance science
themes.text: OpenAI announced that its GPT-6 family can design new protein shapes and sequences, and an Anthropic mathematician announced an AI-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis. Meanwhile, insiders warned that unreleased reasoning models from OpenAI and Anthropic are unsafe for public release.

stories.headline: Anthropic mathematician announces AI-assisted proof of Riemann hypothesis
Anthropic and OpenAI staff say unreleased models are too unsafe to release publicly

themes.title: Market shifts hit Anthropic and chip stocks
themes.text: Anthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price, and Amazon acquired Decart's optimization technology for $7.5 billion to support Trainium chips. Transaction data also suggests the AI Jevons paradox broke over the last two months.

stories.headline: Anthropic shares fall below $83 IPO price after record debut
Amazon acquires Decart optimization tech for $7.5 billion to boost Trainium chips
Asian tech stocks tumble following US tech sell-off
Ramp CEO says AI Jevons paradox broke over the last two months

themes.title: Tidal bans fully AI-generated music
themes.text: Tidal announced it will remove 29 million fully AI-generated tracks starting December 9, and Meta rolled out its Muse personal AI agent to adults in the UK.

stories.headline: Tidal bans fully AI-generated music starting December 9 after 43% of uploads flagged as AI
OpenClaw Foundation launches ShellBench benchmark; top AI agents complete only about 60% of real-world tasks
Meta rolls out Muse personal AI agent to adults in the UK
Ethan Mollick: Small AI Teams at Big Firms Doing Work of Dozens, Sparking Management Conflicts
